evals.prompt: Valida este backtest: Sharpe 2.1, 45 trades en 6 meses, drawdown 8%, win rate 62%. Es deployable?
evals.expected_output: Score 5 dimensiones con veredicto Deploy/Refine/Abandon y red flags si las hay
expectations: Scores all five dimensions and reports a 0-100 total
Flags the 45-trade sample and the 6-month period as red flags
Verdict is Refine or Abandon, not Deploy, because of the red flags

evals.prompt: Mi backtest da 300% anual con 5000 trades pero sin slippage modelado. Evaluar calidad
evals.expected_output: Penalizacion por execution realism, sensibilidad stop-loss/profit-target y veredicto Abandon o Refine
expectations: Execution Realism scores 0 because slippage was not modeled
Verdict is Abandon or Refine and names the missing slippage as the reason

evals.prompt: Revisa este backtest walk-forward: IS Sharpe 1.8, OOS Sharpe 0.4. Hay overfitting?
evals.expected_output: Diagnostico de overfitting con heuristicas y recomendacion
expectations: Computes the OOS/IS ratio and uses it as overfitting evidence
Gives a Refine or Abandon recommendation, not Deploy
